properties.name: Farakka Barrage
properties.notes: Major barrage across the Ganga diverting water via the Feeder Canal into the Bhagirathi-Hooghly system.

properties.name: Mukutmanipur Dam (Kangsabati)
properties.notes: Earthen reservoir dam at the confluence of the Kangsabati and Kumari rivers in Bankura.

properties.name: Durgapur Barrage
properties.notes: Constructed in 1955 across the Damodar River for irrigation and industrial water supply; SCADA-monitored on NWDP.

properties.name: Teesta Barrage (Gajoldoba)
properties.notes: Built in 1985 at Gajoldoba across the Teesta River to regulate irrigation canals across North Bengal.

properties.name: Jangipur Barrage
properties.notes: Barrage across the upper Bhagirathi River in Jangipur regulating flows downstream of Farakka.

properties.name: Tilpara Barrage
properties.notes: 309 m barrage on the Mayurakshi River near Suri, about 32 km downstream of Massanjore Dam.

properties.name: Prinsep Ghat
properties.notes: Historic 1841 riverfront ghat along the Kolkata bank of the Hooghly River beside Vidyasagar Setu.
